inputs.description: Primary Bernoulli input variables echoed back exactly as received by the solver.

rho.description: Fluid density used in the computation.

config.description: Physics‑relevant solver configuration settings that determine how the computation was performed.

g.description: Gravitational acceleration used in the Bernoulli energy term (m/s^2).

precision.description: Numerical precision threshold used for floating‑point comparisons and rounding.

k_v_min.description: Lower bound for velocity validity range derived from environmental constraints.

k_v_max.description: Upper bound for velocity validity range derived from environmental constraints.

k_p_min.description: Lower bound for pressure validity range derived from environmental constraints.

k_p_max.description: Upper bound for pressure validity range derived from environmental constraints.

units.description: Unit system used for all input and output quantities (e.g., 'SI', 'imperial').

input_mode.description: Indicates which primary variable was missing and solved for (e.g., 'solve_p1', 'solve_v2').

results.description: Computed Bernoulli outputs including pressures, velocities, energies, and environmental range limits.

h1.description: Elevation head at station 1 (echoed or derived).

h2.description: Elevation head at station 2 (echoed or derived).

rho.description: Fluid density used in the computation (echoed).

energy.description: Specific mechanical energy at stations 1 and 2: [E1, E2].

energy_imbalance.description: Difference between E1 and E2 (Bernoulli energy imbalance).

p_min.description: Minimum allowable pressure based on environmental constraints.

p_max.description: Maximum allowable pressure based on environmental constraints.

v_min.description: Minimum allowable velocity based on environmental constraints.

v_max.description: Maximum allowable velocity based on environmental constraints.
